capabilities: Convert a chosen local JUnit XML file into a report note
Count total, passed, failed, errored and skipped test cases
Fold failure, error and system logs into callouts
Warn when declared suite counts differ from actual testcase counts
Batch-create folder reports and compare runs against a saved baseline (Pro)
extras: Freemium: free commands need no account; Pro (folder reports, baseline comparison) requires a $5/month or $15 GitHub Sponsors payment, with GitHub device-flow sign-in. After updates the plugin opens a promotional "What's new" tab suggesting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat (can be disabled). Fixed limits: 2 MiB per XML file, 5,000 testcases, 20,000 characters per log. Mobile, Windows/Linux desktop, light theme and payment flow are untested.
problem: Reading a JUnit XML report inside a vault means parsing raw XML by hand; there is no built-in way to render test counts and failure logs as reviewable notes.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/mo or $15 once)

summary: Converts a local JUnit XML test report into a Markdown note with test counts and folded failure callouts.
